raw_text:
Priya Raman
Platform Engineering Lead, Seattle WA
priya.raman@example.com

Summary
Platform engineering lead with 8 years of experience running cloud infrastructure at scale.

Skills
Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Go, CI/CD, Prometheus, Docker

Experience

Platform Engineering Lead at Northgrid (2021 to 2026)
Ran a fleet of 40 Kubernetes clusters serving 900 microservices.
Defined all infrastructure as Terraform modules reviewed like code.
Operated production workloads on AWS across three regions.
Wrote internal operators and tooling in Go.
Rebuilt the CI/CD platform, cutting deploy times from 40 to 8 minutes.
Built the observability stack around Prometheus and Grafana.

Site Reliability Engineer at Corvid Systems (2018 to 2021)
Containerized legacy services with Docker.

Education
BTech Computer Engineering, Anna University, 2017
